text: Just as Leo approached the empty seat, a girl suddenly rushed toward it and dropped her bag on the desk.

speaker: Sheena
text: Excuse me! This seat is mine now.

speaker: Sheena
text: Well, find another seat. Don't just stand there.

speaker: Sheena
text: What? I got here first. Go find another one!
Leo stepped back, surprised by Sheena's attitude. Nico noticed what happened and looked at Leo apologetically.
It seemed that Leo's first day would not be as peaceful as he had hoped.
